{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Tex-Mex cuisine|Tex-Mex cuisine]]

'''Taco casserole''' is a casserole with taco ingredients.

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Beef|ground beef]]
*1 taco seasoning packet
*3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]]
*3 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]
*8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] (225 g) tomato sauce
*3 [[Cookbook:Tortilla|tortillas]] in bits
*3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] shredded [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]]

==Procedure==
#Brown the ground beef in [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] on medium heat.
#Drain the ground beef.
#Dump the ground beef back in the skillet.
#While on medium heat mix in the taco seasoning, the chili powder, the garlic powder, and the tomato sauce.
#[[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. 
#Mix the ground beef mixture, tortilla bits, and the cheese together in a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|casserole dish]].
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in oven at [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|375°F]] (190°C) for 20 minutes.
#Serve hot.
